protocol.buy_hold: Reuse precommitted passive capped2000 and budget10000; same costs but no SL and not risk-equivalent
protocol.dataset: BTCUSDT 15m user CSV May-September2026; SHA verified, origin not independently authenticated
protocol.development: 2026-05-01 to 2026-08-01 exclusive; first500 bars warm-up only
protocol.execution: Unchanged Lab Decimal simulate. Closed signal, next open fills, fixed ATR distances from signal close centered on actual fill, stop-gap adverse, target-gap capped, both hits stop-first; max1; ignore occupied entries; no same-open reversal. Same initial/risk/notional/collateral rules. Fixed final segment liquidation; monthly positions carry.
protocol.historical_pattern: Reuse COMPLETE prior production-native replay only when CSV, all native software hashes, dates, default PatternConfig and paper settings match. Separate unranked close-fill/no-slippage reference, not substituted for next-open execution.
protocol.limitations: August/September already viewed in previous tasks; retrospective descriptive comparison. No confirmed independent advantage may be claimed from these periods. Synthetic data only in unit tests. Research parameters frozen before these candidates' results.
protocol.limits: Existing CSV16MiB/20000 rows; standalone CPU180s. No paid services, no web/UI/API/production state changes. No parameter search. Sensitivity does not choose parameters.
protocol.network: Official January2023 Binance checksum probe returned ConnectError. Additional-permission attempt aborted with no result. No archives received, no bypass or further retries. Multi-year evaluation blocked.
protocol.regimes: closed-candle ADX14<=20 RANGE, >=25 TREND, otherwise TRANSITION; entry-time attribution only, not future regimes
